Introduction

Cifika is a South Korean singer and producer under MOTHER, who debuted on June 2, 2016. Her album 'ION' was nominated for 'Best Electronic Album' at the 2024 Korean Popular Music Awards. Her latest album, 'Bonfire,' released on November 19, 2024, marks her musical evolution, blending electronic music with alternative folk and pop. CIFIKA has collaborated with artists like Crush and producer Nancy Boy.
